name: c-select-1
title: A basic select component with a list of options
label: Basic
description: A basic select component with a list of options

guidance.bestFor: The minimal pattern: 5 fruits in a dropdown below the trigger, led by a prompt row that clears the pick
agentNotes: On the base twin the `items` entry with a null `value` is the prompt and also lists as a row that resets the choice

whenNotToUse.when: A fruit list where several picks stay checked at once
A list laid over the trigger with the current row lined up on it

name: c-select-2
title: Select with icons and placeholder state
label: Icons
description: Select with icons and placeholder state

guidance.bestFor: App sections such as Dashboard and Security led by muted icons, with a scan icon beside the prompt before any pick
agentNotes: Base `defaultValue` is the first `items` entry, a prompt object with its own icon; the radix twin shows a plain `placeholder` with no icon

name: c-select-3
title: Select component with grouped options and labels
label: Grouped Labels
description: Select component with grouped options and labels

guidance.bestFor: Fruits and vegetables in 2 labeled groups of 3 split by a rule, the prompt kept out of the open list
agentNotes: On the base twin the trigger reads labels from `allItems`, so a third option group must be spread into it beside `fruits` and `vegetables`

whenNotToUse.when: Grouped choices the user would rather search by typing

name: c-select-4
title: Select component with a large list of options
label: Large List
description: Select component with a large list of options

guidance.bestFor: A 100 row generated list that opens over the trigger and scrolls within the space left in the viewport
agentNotes: All 101 `items`, prompt included, mount as `SelectItem` rows with no virtualization; replace them with your options

whenNotToUse.when: A list this long that the user should filter down by typing

name: c-select-5
title: Select component with small trigger size
label: Small Trigger
description: Select component with small trigger size

guidance.bestFor: The sm trigger size on a 3 fruit list, a shorter control for dense forms and toolbars
agentNotes: `placeholder` on `SelectValue` never shows on the base twin, because the null entry in `items` already labels the empty state

name: c-select-6
title: Select component with a subscription plan style
label: Plan Picker
description: Select component with a subscription plan style

guidance.bestFor: A plan picker whose trigger grows to show the chosen plan's name and one line description, built from Item parts
agentNotes: Base `itemToStringValue` sets the form value to the plan `name`, since each option's `value` there is the whole plan object

whenNotToUse.when: Plans shown all at once as cards so every description stays in view

name: c-select-7
title: Select component with item alignment disabled
label: Disabled Item
description: Select component with item alignment disabled

guidance.bestFor: A fruit list where Grapes is shown faded and cannot be picked while the other rows stay open to choice

whenNotToUse.when: The whole control locked so its list never opens

name: c-select-8
title: Select component within a Field with label and description
label: Field With Label
description: Select component within a Field with label and description

guidance.bestFor: A Favorite Fruit label tied to the trigger by id, with a one sentence hint under the control
agentNotes: `htmlFor` on `FieldLabel` matches the trigger `id`; keep the pair unique when this field appears more than once on a page
`FieldDescription` is a plain paragraph the trigger never references; give it an id and point aria-describedby at it

whenNotToUse.when: A required choice that shows an error message under the control

name: c-select-9
title: Select component in an invalid state
label: Invalid
description: Select component in an invalid state

guidance.bestFor: An error state set on both the Field and the trigger, with a message printed below the control
agentNotes: `aria-invalid`, `data-invalid` and the `errors` given to `FieldError` are fixed; drive all 3 from your validation result

name: c-select-10
title: Select component in a disabled state
label: Disabled
description: Select component in a disabled state

guidance.bestFor: The entire control switched off and faded, so its list of fruits cannot be opened at all

name: c-select-11
title: Select component inside a Dialog
label: In Dialog
description: Select component inside a Dialog

guidance.bestFor: A full width fruit picker inside a modal with a title and description, opened from a button
agentNotes: No footer or save action exists, so read the pick from `Select` yourself before the `Dialog` closes

whenNotToUse.when: A modal form with several fields and footer actions to save them

name: c-select-12
title: Select component with multiple selection
label: Multiple Selection
description: Select component with multiple selection

guidance.bestFor: Several fruits checked in one open list, the trigger reading the single name or a count such as 3 fruits selected
agentNotes: `multiple` exists only on the base twin; the radix twin of this example holds a single fruit

whenNotToUse.when: Several picks shown as removable chips the user can search

name: c-select-13
title: Select component inline with Input
label: Inline With Input
description: Select component inline with Input

guidance.bestFor: A narrow status filter of All, Active and Inactive beside a search box in one toolbar row
agentNotes: The search `Input` has only a placeholder and the filter drives nothing; label both and wire them to your list query

whenNotToUse.when: A toolbar that combines conditions on several fields as removable chips

name: c-select-14
title: Select component with Button side by side
label: With Button
description: Select component with Button side by side

guidance.bestFor: A picker that stretches across a row ending in a Submit button, as a quick one field form
agentNotes: Submit is a bare `Button` with no handler and no form around it; read the pick and send it yourself

name: c-select-15
title: Select component with item alignment enabled
label: Item Aligned
description: Select component with item alignment enabled

guidance.bestFor: A list laid over the trigger so the current fruit sits exactly where the trigger text was
agentNotes: Base `alignItemWithTrigger` applies to mouse input only and falls back to a dropdown when space runs short

whenNotToUse.when: A dropdown that always opens below the trigger

name: c-select-16
title: Select with custom access level descriptions
label: Access Levels
description: Select with custom access level descriptions

guidance.bestFor: Permission levels from Full access to No access, each with a short line on what it allows, the trigger keeping the name only
agentNotes: The radix trigger copies the whole row, so only the class hiding `small` on `SelectTrigger` keeps the description out of it

whenNotToUse.when: Access levels laid out at once to compare without opening a list

name: c-select-17
title: Select with colored bullets for status
label: Status Bullets
description: Select with colored bullets for status

guidance.bestFor: Statuses such as In Progress and Rejected marked by small colored dots in the rows and the trigger

whenNotToUse.when: A status filter whose first row covers every status with no dot

name: c-select-18
title: Select with user avatars
label: User Avatars
description: Select with user avatars

guidance.bestFor: A people picker of 10 users with photo avatars under a heading, the trigger repeating a smaller avatar
agentNotes: `users` loads remote Unsplash photos and its `email` is never shown; map your people into `mappedUsers`

whenNotToUse.when: A roster long enough that people are found by typing a name

name: c-select-19
title: Select with status badges
label: Status Badges
description: Select with status badges

guidance.bestFor: A Status: prefix in the trigger ahead of an outlined colored badge, with each row drawn as its own badge

whenNotToUse.when: Statuses marked by a small dot beside plain text

name: c-select-20
title: Select with indicator on the left side
label: Left Indicator
description: Select with indicator on the left side

guidance.bestFor: The check mark moved to the left edge of each row, with the row padding flipped to make room
agentNotes: The left check comes from a `SelectItem` class aimed at its last child span on base and its first on radix; recheck it if item markup changes

name: c-select-21
title: Select with clear button
label: Clear Button
description: Select with clear button

guidance.bestFor: An X in the trigger that empties a controlled framework pick, taking the chevron's place once a value is set
agentNotes: `handleClear` hangs on a `div` with a button role but no tab stop or key handler, so only a pointer can reset the pick

whenNotToUse.when: A reset control paired with an up and down arrow while the field is empty

name: c-select-22
title: Select with custom chevrons up down icon
label: Custom Chevrons
description: Select with custom chevrons up down icon

guidance.bestFor: An up and down chevron pair in place of the stock arrow, swapped for a clearing X when a fruit is chosen
agentNotes: The X calling `handleClear` is a `div` outside the tab order with no key handler, so keyboard users cannot clear the value

whenNotToUse.when: A reset control that leaves the stock arrow in place while empty

name: c-select-23
title: Multi-select with overlapping dots
label: Overlapping Dots
description: Multi-select with overlapping dots

guidance.bestFor: Statuses such as Ready, Building and Error, several picked at once and summed up as overlapping dots and a count badge
agentNotes: `multiple` is base only; the radix copy holds one status, its trigger mirroring the chosen row with no stacked dots or count badge

whenNotToUse.when: Many picks that the user narrows by typing and keeps as chips

name: c-select-24
title: Select with grouped options and separators
label: Grouped Separators
description: Select with grouped options and separators

guidance.bestFor: Frontend and backend tech under 2 headings with a divider, from React and Vue to Node.js and Go
agentNotes: Base `allItems` spreads `frontend` and `backend` for the trigger labels, so any new group array has to be spread into it as well

whenNotToUse.when: Grouped rows that also show a muted secondary value beside each name

name: c-select-25
title: Country picker select with flag emojis
label: Country Flags
description: Country picker select with flag emojis

guidance.bestFor: Countries led by their flag emoji in the rows and the trigger, with United States chosen on load
agentNotes: Windows draws each `flag` emoji as a pair of letters, since it ships no flag glyphs; use images where that matters

whenNotToUse.when: A full list of about 200 countries that needs a search box

name: c-select-26
title: Status filter select with colored dots
label: Status Filter
description: Status filter select with colored dots

guidance.bestFor: A filter that starts on an All Status row with no dot, above 4 states that each carry one
agentNotes: All Status is a real option whose value is `all`, not an empty pick, so treat it as no filter in your query

name: c-select-27
title: Select with description text per option
label: Option Descriptions
description: Select with description text per option

guidance.bestFor: Startup, Business and Enterprise tiers with a muted subtitle under each, the trigger keeping the tier name alone
agentNotes: The radix trigger copies the row, so the class hiding `text-muted-foreground` spans on `SelectTrigger` keeps the subtitle out

whenNotToUse.when: A plan trigger that keeps the description in view after the pick

name: c-select-28
title: Timezone select with UTC offsets
label: Timezone Offsets
description: Timezone select with UTC offsets

guidance.bestFor: Timezone codes grouped by Americas, Europe and Asia, each row trailed by its UTC offset in muted text
agentNotes: Add a zone to its region array; base `allItems` turns all 3 into the code and offset labels the trigger prints

whenNotToUse.when: Every world zone in one long list that needs a search

name: c-select-29
title: Select with avatar items for team member assignment
label: Team Assignment
description: Select with avatar items for team member assignment

guidance.bestFor: An Assign to list of 4 teammates with photos, the first of them chosen on load
agentNotes: `members` points each `avatar` at a remote Unsplash photo; swap in your team and keep `initials` for the fallback

whenNotToUse.when: Several assignees picked at once and shown as chips

name: c-select-30
title: Priority select with colored badges
label: Priority Badges
description: Priority select with colored badges

guidance.bestFor: Priority levels from No Priority to Urgent as small outline, solid and light badges in the rows and the trigger
agentNotes: Base `defaultValue` is the string none while every `SelectItem` takes a whole object, so the trigger opens on an empty badge; pass a `priorities` entry

whenNotToUse.when: Statuses drawn as outlined badges after a fixed prefix in the trigger

name: c-select-31
title: Font family select with preview
label: Font Preview
description: Font family select with preview

guidance.bestFor: Each font option set in its own typeface, Inter, Mono and Serif, in the rows and the trigger
agentNotes: The Inter row only applies `font-sans`, so it shows your theme's sans face, which may not be Inter

name: c-select-32
title: Select with icon-labeled categories
label: Category Icons
description: Select with icon-labeled categories

guidance.bestFor: File types such as Documents, Images and Archives led by an icon, which stays beside the name in the trigger

name: c-select-33
title: Size variant select with small trigger
label: Size Scale
description: Size variant select with small trigger

guidance.bestFor: A 4 step size scale from Small to Extra Large behind the compact sm trigger
